_readme: Sponsor spot for Daily Design. The first entry with active=true (and today's date inside its optional start/end, YYYY-MM-DD) is the sponsor. There are two placements. Near the top of the index, report pages and editions ("top"), and on the index above Recent links ("links"), there is a 4:1 landscape banner (1200x300) labelled Sponsored: the sponsor's banner image when banner.active is true and today is inside banner.start/end, otherwise a text card with its logo, name and line. With no active sponsor for a placement, its banner shows a 'Your ad here' placeholder linking to contact.html, and a short 'Sponsor Daily Design' invite always sits below each banner. Fields: name, line (one short sentence), url (https), logo (an https URL or a repo path such as assets/sponsors/acme.png), active, start, end, and banner {type ("image", "animated" = GIF/animated WebP, or "video" = MP4/WebM; default image), webm (optional WebM source for video), audio (true for an https video with sound; repo files are checked automatically), poster (static 1200x300 frame, required for video and animated; shown to reduced-motion visitors), placements (where the banner shows: "top" = top of the index, reports and editions; "links" = the second spot on the index, above Recent links; one or both; default ["top"]), image (https URL or repo path, 1200x300 PNG/JPG/WebP, max 300 KB; animated max 1.5 MB; video max 4 MB and 30 s, may have audio: always starts muted, with a per-ad sound button), alt (text describing the ad), url (click URL, https; defaults to url), active, start, end}. Links get rel="sponsored noopener". Sponsors are display-only and never affect what is picked or how it ranks. Run tools/publish.py after editing. Banner spec: tools/PUBLISHING.md. rates: the contact page rate card (currency, unit, note, footnote, packages [{id, label, desc, static, motion}]); edit the numbers and re-run tools/publish.py. placeholders: house videos for empty placements, {top|links: {video (MP4), webm, poster, alt, audio}}; unset = the 'Your ad here' card.
